critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/mobile.py mobile_map_properties still has a per-property N+1 latest-Visit sub-select (lines ~615-617); OK at current scale, recommend a single windowed query (DISTINCT ON property_id ORDER BY visited_at DESC) once property counts grow.

_authorized_territory_ids is still defined but the map endpoint no longer calls it. Consider deleting or moving it to the canvass module to avoid the impression that the map is territory-gated. Non-blocking.

buildMapLoadDiagnostic exports both `property_feature_count` and `property_source_feature_count` with identical values; consider removing the redundant `property_source_feature_count` or making it the pre-filter count.

canvass.buildAllSectionsFC passes geometry by reference to the FC. Safe for read-only consumption, but if a future caller mutates a feature's geometry it will bleed back into the source section — recommend `structuredClone(s.geometry)` or freeze.
Phase-3 map response does not include an ETag/Last-Modified; every My Area foreground refresh re-scans all properties. Consider a lightweight `updated_at` max header for cheap client 304s at scale.

rca of the issue: Not a bug pass. The applied Phase 3/4 fixes (map endpoint no longer canvass-gated + MapScreen renders all assigned sections + on-load diagnostic) are now permanently guarded by named contract tests. Root cause of the original P0 (empty pins/polygons for a sales user with sections) was that the map response was territory-derived; if a user's section assignment didn't resolve on the request path, BOTH the map AND canvass returned empty (shared failure mode). Phase 3 decouples the two: master map is always the full map-safe set for any Field user; canvass isolation is enforced only on the canvass endpoints via assigned_user_id + active.
